title: G-EDM: add confirmed M-codes and manual skim pauses to g-edm.cps

labels.name: source:agent
labels.description: Opened by an AI agent (not a human reporter)

labels.name: effort:high
labels.description: Several crates, new behaviour with tests; safety floor (issue-worker-high)

body:
Update `assets/posts/g-edm.cps` with any firmware-confirmed M-codes, feed-word behavior, and safe `M00` skim-pass pauses (`#538`) after the reporter answers `#2697`.

## Context

Public `gedm.org` documentation states that G-EDM switches DC spark power in firmware and ignores `F` words in 2D wire mode, while standard Grbl throws `error:22` if `G1` runs with no modal `F` set. Because `g-edm.cps` starts with conservative 2-axis defaults and refuses `skims`, we need the reporter's test feedback on `#2697` to verify `F` requirements, spark/pump/wire M-codes (`M3`/`M5`, `M8`/`M9`), and `M00` pause workflow for skim power changes.

## What this does

- Review the reporter's sample program and dry-run feedback on `#2697` (Clean-Room Protocol: use only observed behavior and public documentation, never `G-RBLv3` source code).
- Update `assets/posts/g-edm.cps` for any confirmed M-codes, feed-word requirements (`F` on `G1` if `G-RBLv3` enforces `error:22`), and end-of-program return to the start point.
- For `skims` (`#538`), emit `M00` with an operator comment to adjust generator power at each pass if confirmed safe, or keep the explicit named refusal and record why in `docs/decisions/`.
- Update `crates/app/tests/g_edm_post.rs` goldens and `crates/post/tests/` cases to lock every change.

## Done means:

- `g-edm.cps` matches the confirmed `G-RBLv3` M-code, feed-word, and skim-pause behavior (or documents permanent refusals in `docs/decisions/`).
- Golden and refusal tests pass via `cargo xtask gate test g_edm --crate camcraft-app` and `cargo xtask gate test script_g_edm --crate camcraft-post`.

Part of #2697
